text:
Which statement describes a hydrated salt?
A
It is an aqueous solution of a salt.
B
It is a solid salt that is chemically combined with water.
C
It is a solid salt that contains no water.
D
It is a salt that has been broken down by water.

options.label: A
options.text: It is an aqueous solution of a salt.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a solid salt that is chemically combined with water.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a solid salt that contains no water.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a salt that has been broken down by water.
